fidelity: F2a — Air-Cathode Electrochemical Model with Thermal ODE
source: Deiss et al. (2002) Electrochim. Acta 47, 3995-4010; Mao & White (1992) J. Electrochem. Soc. 139, 1105; Schroder & Krewer (2014) Electrochim. Acta 117, 541-553; Fu et al. (2010) J. Electrochem. Soc. 157(1), A50-A56; Parker et al. (2017) Science 356, 415-418

unit.name: Single rechargeable Zn-air cell — Physics-Lumped Air-Cathode Electrochemical

A_electrode.note: Geometric air-electrode area (Schroder & Krewer 2014 bench cell)

E_eq.note: Equilibrium cell potential Zn|O2 at 1 atm O2, alkaline (E0_Zn=-1.25 V vs ORR +0.40 V => 1.65 V). Linden's Handbook of Batteries

dE_dT.note: Reversible entropic coefficient dE_eq/dT < 0 for Zn-air. Parker et al. (2017); Chotard et al. (2014)

j0_orr.note: ORR exchange current density on air-electrode (carbon/MnO2 GDE) in KOH. Deiss et al. (2002); Schroder & Krewer (2014)

alpha_orr.note: Cathodic transfer coefficient for oxygen reduction (Tafel slope ~ 120 mV/dec at alpha=0.5)

j0_zn.note: Zn dissolution exchange current density in KOH (fast, near-reversible). Mao & White (1992)

alpha_zn.note: Anodic transfer coefficient for Zn oxidation

E_act.note: Apparent activation energy of air-cathode kinetics in KOH. Lee et al. (2011) Int. J. Hydrogen Energy 36(14)

j_L.note: Air-electrode O2 mass-transport limiting current density (diffusion through GDL at ambient air, pO2=0.21 atm). Deiss et al. (2002); typical commercial Zn-air 0.2-0.4 A/cm2

R_ohm_area.note: Area-specific ohmic resistance: KOH electrolyte + separator + contacts. 6 M KOH conductivity ~0.6 S/cm, gap ~0.1 cm. Schroder & Krewer (2014)

cp_cell.note: Effective specific heat (Zn + KOH + casing average)

hA_loss.note: Convective heat-loss coefficient * area to ambient (natural convection, air-breathing cell)

current_density.note: Must stay below j_L of air electrode
